findings.claim: Cross Analysis has contents:write, scheduled and workflow_run triggers, and commits/pushes generated outputs to main.
evidence: run 41639227879 succeeded on prior main 0acd6407 at 12:51:24Z
findings.impact: Hourly main-branch commits invalidate fresh-main PR bases and create avoidable branch churn.
findings.proposed_control: Use contents:read, checkout with persist-credentials:false, upload bounded workflow artifacts, remove all git add/commit/push commands.

findings.claim: Pillars Consistency Check failed because GitHub App environment values were empty, Databricks SQL returned HTTP 403, and Hugging Face Space runtime returned BUILD_ERROR.
evidence: job 125933137136 log: GITHUB_APP_ID, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY and GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ID empty
findings.impact: The workflow currently conflates missing authentication, denied authorization and a real external runtime failure into one nonzero exit. The HF BUILD_ERROR is a genuine service-state failure; missing GitHub App configuration and Databricks 403 need permission/configuration diagnosis.
findings.proposedControl: Keep failures visible; later split checks into PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL with explicit thresholds rather than suppressing them. Do not read or change secrets without authorization.

findings.claim: PRs #1582, #1583 and #1584 are based on 0acd6407, while main advanced to 32d3a1ad; GitHub currently reports mergeable=false.
findings.impact: Their previous exact-head CI results do not make their stale bases current.
findings.proposedControl: Create fresh-main successors only where needed; do not merge stale proposals.

findings.claim: The main branch-protection endpoint returns HTTP 403 to the connected GitHub integration.
evidence: GET branches/main/protection returned Resource not accessible by integration
findings.proposedControl: Request only the specific administrative permission needed for branch-protection read/inspection when available; do not infer protection from protected=true alone.

limitations: No local worktree was available through GitHub; local dirty state is unknown.
The exact reason for the Hugging Face BUILD_ERROR was not inspected in Hugging Face logs.
